description.content:
The customers endpoints are used to manage customers which you have associated analysis with, via the `customer_reference` analysis subject attribute.

Currently, the customers endpoints only refer to customers with [Transaction Analysis](#tag/Transaction-Analyses).

Customers with only [Wallet Analysis](#tag/Wallet-Analyses) will not yield responses from these endpoints
Paginate through all customers, with various sort/filter parameters.

Returns a summary for a customer by ID. The shape of the response depends on the `request` query parameter.

query.description: Type of summary to return. Omit for a full structured summary with analysis IDs. `overview`, `wallet`, or `transaction` return an LLM narrative. `wallet_ids` or `transaction_ids` return the highest-risk items with their hash and analysis ID.

response.name: Customer summary. Shape depends on `request` query param: `SummaryResult` when omitted, LLM narrative string for `overview`/`wallet`/`transaction`, or `MaxRiskTrigger[]` for `wallet_ids`/`transaction_ids`.
